answer_2.quote: We evaluate the reasoning ability of LLMs with three metrics: Maj@k measures the majority vote correctness..., RM@k measures the best solution correctness..., Pass@k measures whether at least one of the model's k sampled outputs is correct.

answer_3.quote: The verifier's feedback dictates the scaling direction of each TTS method. ... we adopt Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B as the step-level verifier to investigate fine-grained Hybrid Test-Time Scaling.
